task.title: Project detail view description box should grow to fit content
task.description:
The description box in the detail view only shows about 5 lines before needing to scroll. It is resizeable, but this default view cuts off most of the text and always needing to resize a box is a bad user experience. There is a lot of screen real estate in this window.
The task card should grow vertically to fill the whole window, with Description taking up the extra space. Items below the description (status, priority, labels, Save/back) should remain above the fold: the Description box will still scroll for text that can't fit on the screen.
